meta.title: Secretary
meta.description: Watches your unread GitHub notifications, works out which ones are already over and closes them, and remembers the dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) until they are due. Notes: Alt+Space writes one down anywhere, rules place its category and read its date, and a date can become a reminder in one click; notes move between the list, the archive and the trash, and export as Markdown. Mail goes both ways: the Mail tab lists folders, reads bodies, searches, marks, moves, saves attachments, writes, replies and forwards, with drafts kept locally that can also be scheduled to go on their own — and every outgoing message is shown to you as a card before it leaves. Secrets stay in the system keychain.
